name: hedgedoc
title: HedgeDoc
description: Markdown notes that several people write at the same time, with a live preview, slide mode, diagrams and a link to share each note. It keeps its notes in PostgreSQL and uploaded pictures in the App-Data folder. After deploying, open it and register with an e-mail address and a password (no mail is sent), then turn registration off below and deploy again if nobody else should join.

variables.name: HEDGEDOC_PUBLIC_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://notes.example.com. HedgeDoc writes its links with it. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route; opened by this server's address and port it needs nothing

variables.name: HEDGEDOC_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: HEDGEDOC_SESSION_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Signs the sign-in sessions. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: HEDGEDOC_ALLOW_REGISTER
variables.label: Open registration
variables.description: Anyone who can open the page can make an account. Deploy with it on, make your own account, then turn it off and deploy again

variables.name: HEDGEDOC_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS
variables.label: Notes without an account
variables.description: Lets visitors who are not signed in make notes
